cases.name: testChangeClassDefinition
cases.src:
CLASS tests DEFINITION PUBLIC .
  METHODS any_method
    FOR TESTING .
  METHODS other_methoy
    REDEFINITION .
  ALIASES:
    third_method
      FOR if_any_interface~third_method " comment
    , fourth_method
      FOR if_any_interface~fourth_method " comment
    .
ENDCLASS .
cases.exp:
CLASS tests DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  METHODS any_method
    FOR TESTING.
  METHODS other_methoy
    REDEFINITION.
  ALIASES:
    third_method
      FOR if_any_interface~third_method, " comment
    fourth_method
      FOR if_any_interface~fourth_method. " comment
ENDCLASS.

cases.name: testMoveAcrossCommentLines
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    CLEAR:
      ev_any_value  ,
      ev_other_value " line-end comment
*      comment line A
      , ev_third_value
*      comment line B1
      " comment line B2
      , ev_fourth_value " line-end comment
*      comment line C1
       " comment line C2
    .
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    CLEAR:
      ev_any_value,
      ev_other_value, " line-end comment
*      comment line A
      ev_third_value,
*      comment line B1
      " comment line B2
      ev_fourth_value. " line-end comment
*      comment line C1
    " comment line C2
  ENDMETHOD.
